## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this change achieves and its rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking addition to functionality or architecture)
- [ ] Security control / Policy update
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Chore

## DevSecOps & Security Checklist
- [ ] All code comments, documentation, and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, tokens, or credentials are added in code, logs, or commits.
- [ ] Third-party dependencies are pinned to specific versions.
- [ ] No arbitrary dynamic execution or unsafe shell commands introduced.
- [ ] Unit tests and contract tests pass locally (`make test && make contracts-validate`).
- [ ] Policy unit tests pass locally (`make policy-test`).
- [ ] Architectural impacts are documented in an ADR if applicable.
